description: Debug-only automation socket (screenshots, JS eval, DOM inspection via tauri-plugin-playwright). build.rs only includes this file's capability when Cargo's `DEBUG` build-script env var is "true" — the same signal `#[cfg(debug_assertions)]` uses in lib.rs to register the plugin in the first place. A release build never sees this permission granted, even if the debug_assertions gate on the plugin registration were ever accidentally dropped.
